05 LIVE BROADCAST

Go live with a technician.

The best time to discover a quiet microphone or a missing slide is before the audience joins. A studio livestream starts with a short running order and a private technical rehearsal.

Plan a livestream ↗Session rates ↗

01 SESSION NOTES

A rehearsal, one destination and a replay.

01

Before the broadcast

Choose the destination and nominate the person who controls the channel. Send us slides, speaker names and any video inserts so we can rehearse the opening and the handovers.

02

While you’re presenting

The operator monitors the mixed sound, switches cameras on the ATEM Mini Pro and runs the agreed on-screen material. A presenter can concentrate on the guest or the audience questions.

03

After you finish

The proposed €195 pilot covers a technical rehearsal, up to an hour of broadcast to one destination and a local replay. Extra platforms, remote contributors and post-production need their own scope.

02 BEFORE YOU RECORD

Good questions.

Can a guest join remotely?

Include their location and platform when you plan the session. We’ll confirm a return-audio test before agreeing the live setup.

Can you help publish a prerecorded video instead?

Yes, that is a separate publishing task. Tell us the channel, release date and what files or captions need preparing.

SESSION PLANNER

Put your session on paper.

Choose a starting point and save a brief. Pilot prices and dates are confirmed separately.
